extra_vocab.en: an act that breaks a rule, a law, or an agreement
extra_vocab.note: violation 指違反規定、法律或合約的行為，多益常見於交通違規、安全規定、公司政策與合約的公告或信件，語氣正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「違反某規定」用 violation of + 規定，介系詞用 of，不是 to；in violation of 表示「違反了…」。

example.en: The inspector found three violations during the factory visit.
example.zh: 檢查員在參觀工廠時發現了三項違規。

example.en: He paid a fine for a traffic violation yesterday.
example.zh: 他昨天為了一項交通違規繳了罰款。

example.en: Working without a helmet is in violation of company rules.
example.zh: 沒戴安全帽工作違反公司規定。

example.en: The plant was closed after a serious safety violation.
example.zh: 這間工廠在發生嚴重的安全違規後被關閉了。

examples.en: Any violation of this policy may lead to a penalty.
examples.zh: 任何違反這項政策的行為都可能受到處罰。

examples.en: The supplier is responsible for any violation of the contract.
examples.zh: 供應商須為任何違反合約的行為負責。

examples.en: Sharing your password is a clear violation of our security rules.
examples.zh: 分享你的密碼明顯違反我們的資安規定。

confusable.diff: violence 是暴力；violation 是違規，兩個字拼法相近但意思不同。

example.en: The company has a strict rule against violence at work.
example.zh: 公司嚴格禁止在工作場所使用暴力。

similar.diff: breach 常接 of contract、of security，語氣更正式；violation 也可指一般的違規。

example.en: The company reported a breach of its security system.
example.zh: 公司通報了一起資安系統遭突破的事件。

example.en: There is a penalty for late payment on every order.
example.zh: 逾期付款會被處罰。

example.en: The company paid a large fine last year.
example.zh: 這間公司去年繳了一筆很大的罰款。

example.en: New safety regulations for all factory workers start next month.
example.zh: 新的安全規定下個月開始實施。

derived.link: 最基礎的動詞，意思是違反規定、法律

senses.en: an act that breaks a rule or a law

example.en: The driver received a ticket for a parking violation.
example.zh: 這位駕駛因為違規停車收到了罰單。

senses.en: an act that harms a person's rights
senses.distinguish: 後面接 privacy、rights 等字時，指權利被侵犯。

example.en: Reading private emails is a violation of employee privacy.
example.zh: 讀取私人電子郵件是侵犯員工隱私。

extra_vocab.zh: 販賣（尤指用販賣機或在街頭）
extra_vocab.en: to sell things, often from a machine or on the street
extra_vocab.note: vend 本身不常單獨使用，多益主要出現在 vending machine（自動販賣機）和 vendor（小販、供應商）。一般說「賣」多用 sell。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 自動販賣機是 vending machine，用 vending（V-ing 當形容詞），不是 vend machine。

example.en: This machine vends hot coffee and cold drinks all day.
example.zh: 這台機器全天販售熱咖啡和冷飲。

example.en: The company vended snacks in the lobby for two years.
example.zh: 這家公司在大廳販售點心有兩年了。

example.en: Street vending is not allowed near the train station.
example.zh: 火車站附近不准在街頭擺攤販賣。

example.en: The vending machine is next to the break room.
example.zh: 自動販賣機就在休息室旁邊。

example.en: Please keep the vending area clean after lunch.
example.zh: 午餐後請保持自動販賣區的整潔。

example.en: A vending company fills the machines every Monday morning.
example.zh: 自動販賣機業者每週一早上會補貨。

examples.en: Our building will vend drinks on the first floor.
examples.zh: 我們的大樓會在一樓販售飲料。

examples.en: Some small shops vend fruit and flowers near the market.
examples.zh: 市場附近有些小店販售水果和花。

examples.en: The festival lets local farmers vend their products for free.
examples.zh: 這個節慶讓當地農民免費販售他們的產品。

confusable.diff: vent 是通風口，拼法只差一個字母，意思與販賣無關。

example.en: Please do not block the vent in the server room.
example.zh: 請不要擋住機房裡的通風口。

similar.diff: sell 是一般用語，什麼場合都能用；vend 多指用販賣機或在街頭賣，較少單獨使用。

example.en: We sell office supplies to schools and small businesses.
example.zh: 我們把辦公用品賣給學校和小型企業。

example.en: They plan to sell the old building next year.
example.zh: 他們打算明年賣掉這棟舊大樓。

example.en: She works in retail and meets many customers.
example.zh: 她在零售業工作，會接觸許多客人。

derived.link: vend + -or，做事的人，像 actor、visitor，指賣東西的人或公司

extra_vocab.en: a musical instrument with four strings that you play with a bow
extra_vocab.note: violin 是小提琴，多益常見於音樂會、課程招生、餐廳或活動的公告，也常和 piano、concert 等字一起出現。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 演奏樂器要加 the：play the violin；球類運動則不加 the，兩者不要搞混。

example.en: The orchestra bought three new violins for its young players.
example.zh: 管弦樂團為年輕的團員買了三把新的小提琴。

example.en: My manager plays the violin in a small band.
example.zh: 我的經理在一個小樂團裡拉小提琴。

example.en: She takes a violin lesson every Saturday afternoon.
example.zh: 她每個星期六下午上一堂小提琴課。

example.en: Tickets for the violin concert go on sale tomorrow.
example.zh: 小提琴演奏會的票明天開始發售。

examples.en: The famous violin player will perform at the city hall.
examples.zh: 這位有名的小提琴家將在市政廳演出。

examples.en: A violin plays softly while guests enjoy their dinner.
examples.zh: 客人用餐時，小提琴聲輕輕地響著。

examples.en: Our music school offers classes in violin and piano for children.
examples.zh: 我們的音樂學校為兒童開設小提琴和鋼琴課程。

confusable.diff: viola 是中提琴，比 violin 稍大，聲音較低沉。

example.en: The viola player joined the orchestra last spring.
example.zh: 這位中提琴手去年春天加入了管弦樂團。

example.en: There is a piano in the hotel lobby.
example.zh: 飯店大廳裡有一架鋼琴。

example.en: He plays the guitar at the company party.
example.zh: 他在公司的派對上彈吉他。

example.en: The orchestra will give a concert next Friday.
example.zh: 管弦樂團下週五會舉辦一場音樂會。

derived.link: violin + -ist，演奏或從事某事的人，像 pianist、artist

extra_vocab.en: a team sport in which players hit a ball over a net with their hands
extra_vocab.note: volleyball 是排球，多益常見於公司活動、社團、學校課程與運動中心的公告，常搭配 play、team、court 等字。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 球類運動前不加 the：play volleyball；樂器才說 play the violin。

example.en: The gym bought six new volleyballs for the summer program.
example.zh: 體育館為暑期課程買了六顆新排球。

example.en: Our staff play volleyball together every Friday after work.
example.zh: 我們的員工每週五下班後會一起打排球。

example.en: The school volleyball team won the city contest.
example.zh: 學校排球隊贏得了全市比賽。

example.en: The new volleyball court opens at the sports center today.
example.zh: 新的排球場今天在運動中心開放。

examples.en: The company will hold a volleyball game for all employees.
examples.zh: 公司將為全體員工舉辦一場排球比賽。

examples.en: Join our volleyball club and make friends after work.
examples.zh: 加入我們的排球社，下班後交朋友。

examples.en: Beginners can take a volleyball class on Tuesday evenings.
examples.zh: 初學者可以參加週二晚上的排球課。

example.en: We watched a basketball game after the meeting.
example.zh: 我們在會議結束後看了一場籃球賽。

example.en: The hotel has a tennis court for guests.
example.zh: 這間飯店有提供給住客的網球場。

senses.en: a sport played by two teams with a net

example.en: Volleyball is popular among the young staff at our office.
example.zh: 排球在我們辦公室的年輕員工之間很受歡迎。

senses.en: the ball used in the sport of volleyball
senses.distinguish: 前面有 a、the 或數字，或接 buy、pump 等動作時，指球本身。

example.en: Please put the volleyball back in the storage room.
example.zh: 請把排球放回儲藏室。

extra_vocab.en: a sweet flavor used in ice cream, cakes, and drinks
extra_vocab.note: vanilla 是香草，多益常見於餐廳菜單、咖啡店與烘焙食品的介紹，常見於 vanilla ice cream、vanilla latte。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: vanilla 當「香草」時不可數，不加 s；用來修飾別的名詞時當形容詞，不用改形，如 vanilla cake。

example.en: The café serves apple pie with vanilla ice cream.
example.zh: 這間咖啡店的蘋果派附香草冰淇淋。

example.en: Add one teaspoon of vanilla extract to the mixture.
example.zh: 請在混合物裡加入一茶匙香草精。

example.en: I would like a vanilla latte with less sugar, please.
example.zh: 我想要一杯少糖的香草拿鐵。

examples.en: Our most popular flavor is vanilla, followed by chocolate.
examples.zh: 我們最受歡迎的口味是香草，其次是巧克力。

examples.en: The cake has a light vanilla taste and a soft texture.
examples.zh: 這款蛋糕有淡淡的香草味和柔軟的口感。

examples.en: We ordered ten boxes of vanilla cookies for the event.
examples.zh: 我們為活動訂了十盒香草餅乾。

example.en: Customers can add chocolate to their coffee for free.
example.zh: 顧客可以免費在咖啡中加巧克力。

example.en: The shop sells fresh strawberry cake on weekends.
example.zh: 這家店週末販售新鮮的草莓蛋糕。

example.en: We will launch a new flavor next month.
example.zh: 我們下個月會推出新的口味。

example.en: This dessert is made with real vanilla from Madagascar.
example.zh: 這道甜點是用來自馬達加斯加的真香草製成。

example.en: Please order two vanilla cakes for tomorrow's meeting.
example.zh: 請為明天的會議訂兩個香草蛋糕。

extra_vocab.en: to break a rule, a law, or an agreement
extra_vocab.note: violate 是正式用字，指違反規定、法律、合約，多益常見於公司政策、安全規定與合約條款的情境。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: violate 是及物動詞，後面直接接規定或法律，不加 against：violate a rule。

example.en: Any action that violates the law will be reported.
example.zh: 任何違反法律的行為都會被通報。

example.en: The supplier violated several terms of the agreement last year.
example.zh: 這位供應商去年違反了合約中的好幾項條款。

example.en: Employees violating the dress code will receive a warning.
example.zh: 違反服裝規定的員工會收到警告。

example.en: Do not violate a rule that protects customer data.
example.zh: 不要違反保護客戶資料的規定。

example.en: The company was fined for violating the law on safety.
example.zh: 這間公司因違反安全相關法律而被罰款。

example.en: Paying late may violate a contract with our partner.
example.zh: 延遲付款可能違反我們與合作夥伴的合約。

examples.en: Employees who violate this policy may lose their jobs.
examples.zh: 違反這項政策的員工可能會失去工作。

examples.en: Sharing client files with outsiders violates our security rules.
examples.zh: 把客戶檔案分享給外人違反我們的資安規定。

examples.en: The app was accused of violating users' privacy.
examples.zh: 這款應用程式被指控侵犯使用者的隱私。

confusable.diff: violent 是形容詞「暴力的」；violate 是動詞「違反」，拼法相近。
confusable.usage: violent 是形容詞，後面接名詞；violate 是動詞，後面接規定或法律。

example.en: The company does not allow violent behavior in the workplace.
example.zh: 公司不允許在職場有暴力行為。

similar.diff: break 是口語常用字，如 break a rule；violate 較正式，常見於公告與法律文件。

example.en: Please do not break the safety rules in the lab.
example.zh: 請不要違反實驗室裡的安全規定。

example.en: The new policy starts on the first of June.
example.zh: 新政策從六月一日開始實施。

example.en: Our products follow all safety regulations in the European market.
example.zh: 我們的產品遵守所有安全規定。

derived.link: violate 去掉 e + -ion，把動作變名詞，像 reservation、education
violate 去掉 e + -or，做事的人，像 actor、visitor

senses.en: to break a rule, a law, or an agreement

example.en: Selling the product without a license violates the national law.
example.zh: 沒有執照就販售這項產品違反國家法律。

senses.en: to harm someone's rights or private life
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 privacy、rights 這類字時，指侵犯。

example.en: Recording customers without asking violates their right to privacy.
example.zh: 未經詢問就錄下顧客，侵犯了他們的隱私權。

extra_vocab.en: a meeting where people in different places see and talk to each other on screens
extra_vocab.note: videoconference 是視訊會議，多益常見於跨國會議、遠距工作與會議通知，常搭配 hold、join、schedule 等動詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 介系詞用 by 或 via：by videoconference（以視訊會議方式），前面不加冠詞。

example.en: We hold two videoconferences each week with our overseas office.
example.zh: 我們每週與海外辦公室召開兩次視訊會議。

example.en: We will hold a videoconference with the Tokyo team on Monday.
example.zh: 我們週一會與東京團隊召開視訊會議。

example.en: Please join the videoconference five minutes before it starts.
example.zh: 請在視訊會議開始前五分鐘加入。

example.en: The interview will be conducted by videoconference this Thursday.
example.zh: 這次面試將於本週四以視訊會議方式進行。

examples.en: The videoconference link will be sent to you by email.
examples.zh: 視訊會議的連結會用電子郵件寄給你。

examples.en: A videoconference saves time because nobody has to travel.
examples.zh: 視訊會議能節省時間，因為沒有人需要出差。

examples.en: The sound was poor, so we ended the videoconference early.
examples.zh: 聲音很差，所以我們提早結束了視訊會議。

confusable.diff: teleconference 是遠距會議，不一定有畫面，常指電話會議；videoconference 一定有視訊畫面。

example.en: We held a teleconference by phone because the network was down.
example.zh: 網路中斷，所以我們用電話開了遠距會議。

similar.diff: video call 較口語，常指一對一或小組通話；videoconference 較正式，多用於正式會議。

example.en: I will make a video call to my client tonight.
example.zh: 我今晚會跟客戶視訊通話。

example.en: The meeting starts at ten in the main office.
example.zh: 會議在十點於總公司開始。

example.en: She will speak at the sales conference next week.
example.zh: 她下週會在銷售大會上發言。

derived.link: videoconference + -ing，把「開視訊會議」這件事變成名詞
